title: Concept: Non-cryptographic thread RNG used where a token may be generated in rust — review required
description: In rust, thread_rng is used. The generator is fast and convenient, but its state is process-local and reachable by any code in the same process; it is not a cryptographically secure source. Security tokens need the OS generator, which is what OsRng provides.
applicability: rust services that mint tokens, nonces or identifiers.
risk: Predictable tokens enabling guessing; MEDIUM severity.
